messages:
Anya K: FYI starting staggered deploy of quant-kernel v3.4 to night-bucket at 23:00 PT. Primary goals: lower mem for matmul, keep latency within SLO. Deploybot will kick off canary.

deploy-bot: preflight checks OK. CI: green. Starting canary on 5% of capacity (g4 and a10 pools). Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/quant-kernel-rolls :rocket: 

Miguel R: Rollback criteria? thresholds?

Anya K: If p50 matmul latency > baseline +12% for 5m OR p95 > baseline +20% for 1m -> immediate rollback. Also if kv-cache miss rate increases >8% sustained for 10m. Also fail on >0.5% RPC error rate delta.

Liz H: Please also watch prefix-evictions metric and OOMs. Add an alert on kernel.oob_count > 0 (we saw a weird OOB last time).

Ryan O: I'll take handover for midnight window. If anything odd ping me and @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Observability hooks added, dashboards pinned. Alerting policies updated. Quiet hours escalation set to page after 3 consecutive alerts.

Miguel R: Can we pin traffic to v3.3 easily if needed? command?

Anya K: Yep: `deploypin --service=quant-runtime --version=v3.3 --scope=night-bucket` —tested in staging. Also `deploy rollback --to v3.3` exists but pin is faster (no rolling infra changes).

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ 23:12: p50_matmul +3%, p95_matmul +11%, kv_cache_miss +1.2%, rpc_errors +0.02%. No alerts fired yet. Canary healthy.

Anya K: We see a telemetry blip at 23:12 on g4-2 nodes: small p95 spike localized. Holding rollout at 5% while we triage. @Miguel R can you grab a CPU flame and kernel logs from node g4-2-17?

Miguel R: grabbing logs now. `ssh ops@g4-2-17 sudo journalctl -u quant-kernel -n 500 --no-pager` shows a few matmul kernel timeouts ~23:11:57. Uploading snippet to thread.

deposit: (file) g4-2-17-matrix-timeout.log — snippet: `ERROR kernel_matmul: op runtime exceeded 12000us, ctx=quant`.

Liz H: Might be a microcode scheduling artifact — we saw similar with patched cuBLAS last quarter. Check kernel ABI and gpudriver versions on that host.

Miguel R: gpudriver 525.85, kernel-abi 2.7.0 for the host; the build used kernel-abi 2.8.0 artifacts — possible mismatch. Investigating shim behavior.

Anya K: Good catch. If mismatch confirmed we should pin night-bucket back to v3.3 until we reconcile builds. Prefer pin over full rollback so other regions unaffected.

sre-oncall: I'll open a short incident and start a compatibility checklist. If we decide to pin I'll execute `deploypin` with Anya's command.

Ryan O: TL;DR: hold at 5%, no rollback yet. Miguel + Liz to triage ABI mismatch. SRE to prepare pin option and customer comms draft in case wider impact. I'll stay on until 00:30 PT.

Anya K: Agreed. Will update thread when we confirm ABI mismatch or clear. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Miguel R: updating — kernel-abi mismatch confirmed on 3 hosts. Repro steps and logs in the incident. Recommendation: pin to v3.3 for night-bucket and schedule a controlled rollout to update host ABI next week.

Anya K: Proceeding to pin now. Running: `deploypin --service=quant-runtime --version=v3.3 --scope=night-bucket --reason="ABI mismatch on g4-2"`

deploy-bot: Pin complete at 23:47 PT. Traffic frozen to v3.3 in night-bucket. Canary instances terminated. Notifying release-manager.

sre-oncall: Incident created: ID INC-2026-0423-quant-abi. Owners assigned. Will follow up in postmortem.

Anya K: Thanks team. We'll pick this up in morning release sync and add a preflight ABI check to the canary job to prevent recurrence. Night all. :crescent_moon:
